name: --debug
description: Run Gemini CLI in debug mode with verbose logging.

examples.explanation: Start an interactive session with debug logging enabled.
Capture verbose diagnostics during a reproducible headless task.

when_to_use: Use while diagnosing startup, tool, extension, or MCP behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid sharing debug logs before checking them for sensitive paths or values.

name: --model
description: Select the Gemini model for the invocation instead of the automatic default.

examples.explanation: Start with a model listed as available for the current account.

when_to_use: Use when a task requires a specific available model rather than automatic selection.

conditions: Available model identifiers depend on the account and deployment.

name: --prompt-interactive
display_name: Run a prompt then stay interactive
description: Execute an initial prompt and continue in interactive mode after the response.

examples.command: gemini -i "map the authentication flow before we edit it"
examples.explanation: Begin with a focused analysis, then continue the same session interactively.

when_to_use: Use when you want a repeatable initial instruction without ending the session after one response.

name: --sandbox
description: Run Gemini CLI in a sandboxed environment for safer tool execution.

examples.command: gemini --sandbox "run the tests and diagnose failures"
examples.explanation: Perform tool-using work inside the configured sandbox.

when_to_use: Use when commands should be isolated from the broader host environment.

conditions: Sandbox implementation depends on platform and configuration.

name: --yolo
description: Automatically approve actions using the legacy flag; use approval-mode=yolo instead.

examples.explanation: Use the documented replacement for unattended automatic approval.

when_to_use: Use --approval-mode=yolo only in an appropriately isolated environment when automatic approvals are intentional.
when_not_to_use: Do not add --yolo to new scripts because it is deprecated.

name: --experimental-acp
description: Start Gemini CLI in its experimental Agent Client Protocol mode.

examples.explanation: Start the experimental ACP integration mode.

when_to_use: Use while developing or testing an ACP client integration.
when_not_to_use: Do not rely on experimental ACP behavior as a stable production interface.

name: --allowed-mcp-server-names
description: Specify the MCP server names allowed for the invocation as comma-separated values or repeated flags.

examples.explanation: Limit the invocation to the named MCP servers.

when_to_use: Use when an invocation should expose only a controlled subset of configured MCP servers.

conditions: Named servers must exist in Gemini CLI configuration.

name: --extensions
description: Select the extensions enabled for the invocation; when omitted, all installed extensions are enabled.

examples.explanation: Start with only the named extension selected.

when_to_use: Use to narrow an invocation to extensions relevant to the task.

name: --list-extensions
description: List all available Gemini CLI extensions and exit.

examples.explanation: Inspect installed extensions before selecting a subset.

when_to_use: Use before --extensions when you need the exact installed names.

name: --resume
description: Resume a prior session by index or resume the most recent session with the latest selector.

examples.explanation: Continue the most recent saved Gemini CLI session.

when_to_use: Use when returning to a conversation whose context should be preserved.

conditions: The selected saved session must exist.

name: --include-directories
description: Include additional directories in the Gemini CLI workspace using comma-separated values or repeated flags.

examples.explanation: Include sibling library and schema directories in workspace context.

when_to_use: Use when the task depends on files outside the initial working directory.
when_not_to_use: Include only directories relevant to the task to avoid unnecessary context and access.

name: --output-format
description: Select text, JSON, or streaming JSON output for the CLI invocation.

examples.explanation: Return machine-readable output from a headless prompt.

when_to_use: Use JSON formats when another program will consume Gemini CLI output.
